author: Pascal Gienger
attribution: Photo: Pascal Gienger, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:ABJ1.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/de/deed.en. Unmodified original.
notes: Three blue overhead lane signs at Abidjan's Félix Houphouët-Boigny airport: 'P' with subscript 2 and a down arrow, 'AEROGARE DEPART' with two down arrows, 'AUTOCARS' with a diagonal arrow. The terminal lettering behind is hidden by the trees; no-parking pictograms are distractors.

author: abdallahh
attribution: Photo: abdallahh, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/22168167@N00/4017234343. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Tall totem sign at the roadside, Cocody (university area), Abidjan, slightly from below. Capitals written without accents (NUMERIQUE) while the lowercase lines keep them (Accès, à); apostrophes as ASCII. The initials A and U in AGENCE / UNIVERSITAIRE are picked out in red. The 'SPONSOR OFFICIEL Côte d'Ivoire Telecom' panel at the base is a distractor. Alternative queries: 'Agence universitaire de la Francophonie', 'CURAT'.

author: abdallahh
attribution: Photo: abdallahh, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/22168167@N00/8683974471. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Painted cloth banner on a steel frame over a school wall, Deux Plateaux, Abidjan. Written without accents (MINISTERE, EDUCATION, COLLEGE); apostrophe transcribed as ASCII. The right edge of the photo clips the final S of DAUPHINS and the final E of COLLEGE (both partly visible). This is a postal-box address (06 BP 2445), not a street address.

author: Baoulecmoi
attribution: Photo: Baoulecmoi, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Incursion_au_Parc_National_du_Banco_CIV-2023_303.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Five coloured arrow fingerposts on a yellow pole in Parc National du Banco, Abidjan; read left board then right board, top to bottom. The health slogan board above ('POUR LUTTER CONTRE LE DIABETE ...', 'DON LIONS CLUB COTE D'IVOIRE') and its cut-off 'PARC NATIONAL DU BANCO' header are distractors. Alternative queries: 'Parc National du Banco', 'École Forestière'. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

lines.text: DON DES LIONS CLUBS DE COTE D’IVOIRE

notes: 'You are here' board at a trail junction in the forest; small in frame. A crease runs through 'ECOTOURISTIQUE' and 'DU' in the header. The mossy fingerposts below ('SORTIE ESPACE-ECO 2 Km', 'OBSERVEZ LES DIFFERENTS OBSTACLES', 'SORTIE ENTREE ESPACE-ECO') are distractors. Alternative query: 'Carrefour Montagne Martineau'. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: abdallahh
attribution: Photo: abdallahh, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/22168167@N00/4038821338. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Two blue street-name blades at a right angle on one pole, Angré, Cocody, Abidjan, seen from below; gold capitals. The 'RUE L54' blade is at a steep angle. Tiny 'VILLE D'ABIDJAN / COMMUNE DE COCODY' crest text is not transcribed. The 'Styliste Modéliste' shop awning at bottom left is a distractor. Alternative query: 'Rue L54'.

author: abdallahh
attribution: Photo: abdallahh, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/22168167@N00/4036282132. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Blue street-name plate with gold capitals and a gold border, Cocody, Abidjan, slightly from below. The small header 'VILLE D'ABIDJAN' and 'COMMUNE DE COCODY' (split over three lines around the crest) is tiny but legible; the main lines are 'BOULEVARD A5' and 'LATRILLE'. Same blue Cocody style as other Abidjan plates but a different street.

author: Cyriac Gbogou
attribution: Photo: Cyriac Gbogou, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:H%C3%B4pital_g%C3%A9n%C3%A9ral_d%27Adiak%C3%A9.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Gate lintel of the general hospital, Adiaké, shot from a moving vehicle at an angle with slight motion blur; a red cross precedes 'HOPITAL'. The name is cut at the right edge after 'ADIAK' (full 'D'ADIAKE'). No accents painted.

author: COVIMA-Bouaflé
attribution: Photo: COVIMA-Bouaflé, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Covima_transformation_du_cacao_local.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted sign on a wall, Bouaflé: red 'COVIMA' under a logo with a Côte d'Ivoire outline (the logo itself repeats 'CO' and 'IMA'), green slogan with a red arrow. No accent painted on MARAHOUE.

author: osm-operon
attribution: Photo: osm-operon, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Panoramax. Source: https://panoramax.openstreetmap.fr/#focus=pic&pic=4793f75a-d618-4af5-8994-71a3d6721903. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. crop 1887,0,4623,2052 of the 4624x3468 HD picture.
notes: Overhead gantry direction sign seen through the windscreen; the top band shows only an up arrow. The first two names are on green bands, the last two in black on white. The right edge of the frame is blocked by the rear-view mirror; the vertical 'ADJAMÉ' sign at lower left is a distractor. Alternative query: 'Abobo'. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: osm-operon
attribution: Photo: osm-operon, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Panoramax. Source: https://panoramax.openstreetmap.fr/#focus=pic&pic=1a4350db-b85a-4228-9b90-85d150e860ea. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. crop 803,912,2175,1941 of the 4624x3468 HD picture.
notes: Two arrow-shaped direction signs on a pole, Abidjan: green panel 'YAMOUSSOUKRO' over white panel 'YOPOUGON', both pointing right. Alternative query: 'Yamoussoukro'. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
